9197e8136d4570f0113d.en: 80 divided by 4 is 20, so one unit is 20 coins. Nia has 20 coins and Mika has 60.
9197e8136d4570f0113d.id: 80 dibagi 4 adalah 20, jadi satu unit bernilai 20 koin. Nia punya 20 koin dan Mika punya 60.

6d9dce899fc7723642ff.en: Oka has 1 unit more than Pia, and that unit is 30 marbles. So Pia has 30 and Oka has 60.
6d9dce899fc7723642ff.id: Oka punya 1 unit lebih banyak daripada Pia, dan unit itu bernilai 30 kelereng. Jadi Pia punya 30 dan Oka punya 60.
